name: Explain AI's impact on immersive games
description: Users asked for detailed explanations, hypothetical scenarios, and comparisons regarding how different levels of artificial intelligence, such as AGI and ASI, would specifically enhance immersive technologies like video games, virtual reality, and augmented reality. These requests frequently focused on the impact of advanced AI on game mechanics, non-player character behaviors, and users' immersive experiences within digital simulations.
